svg.text: Breast cancer segmentation — coding plan
CBIS-DDSM masses · from empty scaffold to one sealed test evaluation · every step ships its gate before the next begins
MACHINE — probed 2026-09-13
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce MX350, 2048 MiB VRAM, driver 537.58
Python 3.14.3 system-wide · no venv · PyTorch not installed
Disk: 26 GB free of 476 GB (95% used) · data/raw/ is empty
COMPUTE PLAN — agreed
Laptop: audit, manifest, splits, geometry tests, overfit smoke on 8 patches
Cloud (Colab / Kaggle T4 or P100): the real training runs, on ROI patches
Patch size and batch size live in configs; no absolute paths anywhere
IN PLACE
docs, schemas,
course
docs/ · schemas/ · repo tree
PLAN.md, PROTOCOLE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md, REFERENCES.md
4 SVG maps (project + course, EN/FR); full src/ and data/ tree
Protocol already fixed: masses first, patient splits, sealed test
cours/ — 1 of 4 modules
01 disease & mammography — corrected 2026-09-09
02 data · 03 metrics · 04 models — still to write
Not a blocker for the code; needed for the report.
S0
Environment
lock
pyproject.toml · .venv · configs/env.yaml
BLOCKER: Python 3.14.3 has no PyTorch wheels — build a 3.12 venv
torch (cu121), numpy, pandas, opencv, albumentations, scipy,
scikit-image, pyyaml, pytest, tqdm — all versions pinned
GATE
torch.cuda.is_available() returns True
env.yaml records GPU, VRAM, driver, free disk and every
package version, so a cloud run can mirror it exactly.
S1
Acquisition
& manifest
scripts/build_manifest.py · data/manifest.py
Parse the four CBIS-DDSM CSVs (mass / calc × train / test)
One row per lesion: patient, side, view, abnormality, pathology,
density, assessment + resolved image and ROI-mask paths
GATE
Both files exist, mask is binary, mask dims == image dims.
Known trap: this Kaggle mirror swaps the ROI-mask and
cropped-image paths on part of the rows. Detect it, don't assume.
S2
Audit
& exclusions
data/audit.py · notebooks/01_audit.ipynb
Duplicates, dimension mismatch, mask value range, empty masks
Merge multi-lesion rows per (patient, side, view)
Stratified visual sample of overlays → reports/figures/
GATE
data/interim/exclusions.csv, one reason per dropped row.
Counts reported separately — files, lesions, views and
patients are four different numbers. Never quote one for another.
S3
Patient-grouped
splits
data/splits.py · scripts/make_splits.py
Audit the official train / test split for patient leakage first
GroupShuffleSplit on patient_id carves val out of train,
stratified on pathology → data/splits/split_v1.json
GATE
tests/test_splits.py asserts the three patient sets are
pairwise disjoint. Test split is sealed from here on —
no tuning, no peeking, exactly one evaluation at S8.
S4
ROI patches
& Dataset
data/preprocess.py · data/patches.py · data/dataset.py
Breast crop (Otsu + largest component), strip burned-in labels.
ROI patches at NATIVE resolution — never resize the whole mammogram:
3000→512 destroys the spicule (module 4 §5.2). Synced augmentations.
GATE
tests/test_geometry.py — a known transform applied to a
synthetic pair must leave the mask aligned, and the result
must be invertible back into the source image frame.
S5
Baseline
U-Net
models/unet.py · training/losses.py · training/trainer.py
U-Net with an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet encoder, via segmentation_
models_pytorch. Dice + BCE, trained on ROI patches. At ~600 training
anomalies a pretrained encoder is mandatory, not an optimisation.
AMP + grad accumulation at 2 GB. configs/unet_roi.yaml, seed fixed.
GATE — run this before any real training
scripts/overfit_batch.py: 8 images, no augmentation,
must reach Dice > 0.95. If it cannot, the masks are
misaligned or the loss is wrong. A full training run
will not tell you that — it will just look mediocre.
S6
Inference
& metrics
inference/predict.py · evaluation/metrics.py
Threshold, post-process, project the mask back to the source
frame. Dice, IoU, HD95, ASSD; per-lesion sensitivity by
connected component; FP per image; empty-mask rule stated.
GATE
tests/test_metrics.py — synthetic shapes whose Dice and
HD95 are known analytically. Report in pixels unless the
pixel spacing has actually been verified in the source data.
S7
Controlled
comparisons
configs/*.yaml · experiments/<run_id>/
One factor at a time: resolution, pretrained encoder,
boundary-sensitive loss, tiling. Key runs repeated on 3 seeds.
Log commit, config, seeds, manifest id, split id, metrics.
GATE
Identical splits and identical rules for every model.
The final choice is made on validation only. Memory cost
and inference time reported alongside segmentation quality.
S8
Sealed test
& report
scripts/evaluate.py → reports/
Freeze model, threshold and post-processing. Evaluate ONCE.
Break down by density, size, pathology and view, with n shown.
Patient-level bootstrap for uncertainty, not pixel-level.
GATE
Every number ships with its n, its uncertainty and real
failure examples. No claim of general clinical performance
is made from this dataset, per docs/PROTOCOLE.md.
Legend
done & verified
in progress / partial
planned — not written yet
blocked
gate — rule that must hold before the next step starts
Hardware, Python and disk figures probed on this machine on 2026-09-13. Nothing under src/ exists yet: every purple box is a file still to be written.
Research protocol and metric definitions come from docs/PROTOCOLE.md; this schematic only orders the implementation and names its checkpoints.
